target_customer: Cyber, fraud and risk teams at banks, payments and enterprises
problem: Teams drown in noisy threat and risk signals; originally the company monitored news and satellite imagery for global risks to operations and supply chains.
business_model: Enterprise SaaS subscription for AI threat intelligence
product_category: AI threat intelligence and risk operations

founders.name: Arjun Bisen
education: Harvard, technology and risk study on a Fulbright scholarship

founders.name: Tad
founders.background_notes: Named in the YC launch post per the YC page; last name and bio not found.

technical_complexity.rationale: Collecting and classifying open web signals and imagery was standard ML work in 2022, with scale and data access the hard parts.

defensibility.rationale: Early product relied on public data so copying was easy; later source coverage may compound.

market_need_then: The YC launch described demand for automating global risk detection across operations, supply chain and reputation; no quantified spend evidence was gathered.

branding.domain_note: YC lists overwatchdata.ai while the launch post used overwatchdata.io

brand_strength.rationale: Generic name shared with a famous video game and an aviation startup, so search results are crowded.

pivots.from: Monitoring news and satellite imagery for global business risk
pivots.to: AI agents for cyber threat intelligence, brand protection and fraud
pivots.why: Not stated; derived from YC launch description versus current site

outcome_analysis: Overwatch started with global risk monitoring and moved to AI agents for threat intelligence and fraud. It is active, lists Visa and FS-ISAC as customers or partners, and reported a $15M Series A in October 2026, but earlier round data is inconsistent so its funding path is only partly known.
notes: A seed of $7.38M in February 2025 led by PruVen is reported by aggregators only and is unverified; totals before the Series A range from $4.3M to $8M. Caplight shows a conflicting $16M figure. No dated competitor source from 2022 was found; Dataminr and Recorded Future appeared only in undated or recent pages, so the list is empty. Series A date is October 2026 per the saas news article.
